name: Smoke Fixture
description: Minimal third-party plugin exercised by scripts/e2e-smoke.sh: installs through the upload API, runs a sandboxed out-of-process JSON-RPC worker, and covers the FileRef bridge and database-provisioning surfaces. Not distributed anywhere.
author: FengYu

file_read.description: Reads a file inside a host-granted workspace directory.

file_write.description: Writes a file inside a host-granted workspace directory.

db_env.description: Reports the provisioned database URL from the worker process environment.

aiTools.name: smoke_echo
aiTools.description: Echoes the given text back (e2e smoke fixture).
